extension.summary: Live Indian TV in every language, HD first, with automatic failover
extension.description: Free Indian TV channels split by language (Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali and more), with an HD-only view, a TV guide (EPG) and optional JioTV login support. The playlist is rebuilt every 5 minutes and the add-on tests each stream on your own network, switching to a working link when one fails.
Hosts the Telugu Live video add-on, which plays an auto-updating playlist of working free-to-air Telugu TV channels.
